blocks.content: A mobile-friendly design scales up well to larger screens, but the reverse is often not true. Here's why:
Smaller to Larger Screens: A simple mobile design remains readable on larger devices, while additional screen space allows for layout expansion and added features.
Larger to Smaller Screens: A design meant for a large screen can feel cluttered or unreadable on a smaller screen, requiring users to zoom or scroll.

blocks.alt: Fitting Smaller Design On Larger Screen
